reviews.title: A éviter, arnaque
reviews.text: This summer I ordered a round trip with this "company". Both flights were canceled concurrently. Only one was refunded. I'm still waiting for an answer for 3 months for the other one. The flight cancellations were made only 15 days before takeoff. A really unreliable company.
reviews.author: Pierre E

reviews.title: Abhorrent Airline
reviews.text: Our flight from Sumba (TMC) to Bali (DPS) on 2 Jul was cancelled. An email with English title and Bahasa Indonesia content was sent to us on 1 Jul. Nam Air offered us the next available flight on 10 Jul. The supposed cancellation was not due to weather or closure of the airport. Nam Air simply said it's operational reasons. The ticket could be fully refunded, subject to a fee of USD 30 to transfer money to a non-Indonesian account. I would happily pay for this if I canceled the flight. Our driver and guide was supposed to pick us up on 2 Jul so we had to rearrange it with her. She was surprised as according to her knowledge, Nam Air didn't even have a flight on 2 Jul (Saturday) in the first place. When we finally arrived at the airport on 3 Jul to take another flight from another airline, we were told Nam Air's flight on 3 Jul was also canceled. When we checked Nam Air's flight the previous day, 3 Jul was sold out. The airports of TMC and DPS were open the whole day and there were flights from other airlines on the same route the same day. When I asked Nam Air's ground staff, one of them told me "we sell tickets for everyday but we don't have flights everyday". I do no know if there is case of poor translation, or Nam Air simply does sell tickets when they don't even have a planned flight.
reviews.author: www

reviews.title: So Bad !! First time like this with a company…
reviews.text: Bad bad bad bad bad ! They cancelled 2 times our flight without information, no service, and of course : no money « give back » / no provide hotel service for the night / no provide any taxi to go back to the city … waiting 11 hours at the airport in bad conditions. NOTHING. Nobody to inform us, nobody to help us, no confirmation for the next flight… We really regret to take this company, we are traveling a lot and we never met these kind of difficulties. Run away !!!!
reviews.author: Mounboo

reviews.title: Ms
reviews.text: The worst flight ever they rescheduled flight spouse to be morning at 8:35 they rescheduled at 21.35 which is too late and I need to be on jakarta in the morning they send information when I already in airport just wasting my time when I ask them to provide accommodation they were offering for refund money which I can’t get quickly will NEVER EVER USE THIS FLIGHT not recommended,
reviews.author: Erna Y

reviews.title: Nam Air cancelled flight but does not refund our money
reviews.text: Nam cancelled our flight without giving a reason. We asked to refund the price but they refused several times, just offering a voucher. This is unacceptable and we definitely will never fly Nam. This even limits our options to travel to Indonesia, which we did several times before.
reviews.author: Frank

reviews.title: Classic And Old
reviews.text: This is my experience on Nam Air. This route uses a Boeing 737 Series 500 Classic. the plane is very old, the window cover is a little damaged (it can't be closed completely), the seats are torn a lot. but for very good service, ontime.
reviews.author: Ibnu Salam

reviews.title: Worst airline ever
reviews.text: It was so bad our experience with this f airline. First they cancelled our flight so we missed a whole day. Obviously we didn’t get our money back. On the way back the flight was delayed 4 times. Every time I tried to ask they told me a different lie. At the end I said are you lieing to me? Well yes sir. But it will come at some time but we don’t know when. Enough said. Don’t ever make the mistake of flying bam air.
reviews.author: felipecosta247

reviews.title: Flight cancellation
reviews.text: Unfortunately Nam/sriwijaya Air is one of only two airlines that run the route. Flight was cancelled on the day, planned for a delayed departure 27hours later. Keep your travel plans fully flexible if you have to use this airline.
reviews.author: Kusumajt

reviews.title: On Time and good service
reviews.text: This is definitely not the best airline I've ever flown, and also not the worst. The flight was on time, with no problems checking in at all. Only downfall is that you can not check in online, you must do it in person at the airport. The aircraft was a little hot to start with, but it cooled off was in the air. The flight attendants were very nice, friendly, and polite. Seats were comfortable with nothing special. Great cheap way to connect within Indonesia.
reviews.author: The World is My Oyster

reviews.title: Unable to buy baggage online
reviews.text: Flight is on time Food is available on board Price is cheap Free 5kg baggage for sports equipment BUT..... there is no option to buy baggage online. Baggage is expensive too. 91000rp/kg !!
reviews.author: B.T.

reviews.title: Try to avoid
reviews.text: Had such a bad experience with Nam air. First we were told that the flight was leaving a half an hour earlier than scheduled but once we got to the airport it was delayed an hour and a half passed the originally schedule time. Then, half the plane did not get their luggage. We found out they took a container off the flight but load it right back up and sent it back to Bali. Our flight landed at 11:30am and we didn’t get our bags until 9pm. No one at the airport in Comodo spoke English or seem to know what was going on. Luckily the staff from Blue Manta liveaboard was able to communicate with the airline and took care of getting us our bags.
reviews.author: ScubaNYC16

reviews.title: Window seat
reviews.text: I checked in very early for my flight and requested a window seat. I was given seat 10a and was assured it was window seat. This seat is on the window side but it is in fact a blank wall. It is very claustrophobic because the wall is very close to the seat
reviews.author: Darryl B

reviews.title: Do Your Homework If You Are Traveling With Dive Gear
reviews.text: I recently traveled from the United States to dive in Komodo National Park which required me to take a flight from Bali to Labuan Bajo on an Indonesian domestic airline. After checking my options I chose to fly Nam Air because they fly this route on 737s and my wife doesn’t like small planes. The airfare itself was decently priced, but since we were traveling with our own dive gear I knew that we would exceed the baggage allowance. The Nam website was very difficult to navigate and figure out how to pay in advance for extra baggage. Our flight was rescheduled a couple of times, but we were notified each time and it didn’t really affect our plans. When we checked in for the flight from DPS to LBJ it was pretty straightforward. We were charged for more weight, but it didn’t seem to be too far our of range of what many domestic American carriers charge. However, when we checked in for the return flight from LBJ to DPS it was like haggling over a purchase from a street bazaar. We were told it would be the equivalent of around $250 USD. After haggling with the desk agent we were eventually able to cut that in half, but it was still more than we had paid for the first leg. I was really disappointed that the airline didn’t make the process easier in advance. Even if I had paid for more weight than we needed I would have spent less than we wound up paying. I also found out later that some of the airlines that fly smaller planes will give a weight allowance for dive equipment. Lesson learned I guess. The flights themselves were fine. Service was decent, and it was less than an hour total time.
reviews.author: Brad C

reviews.title: Very delayed
reviews.text: I have multiple instances of delayed flights from NAM AIR, and I would never recommend it to people. Just had a 3 hour delay today and it was so frustrating. It's so annoying specially when you have to check in on an accommodation that has time constraint. Just so disappointing.
reviews.author: Girls On Global Adventures

reviews.title: Becoming non Punctual
reviews.text: In the beginning when the airline first started, Nam Air flight to Sampit was punctual. This flight on 26 June 2019 was rescheduled one hour late, beginning to be like competitor airline. The seat is bad and not comfortable too. Now that the National Airline has taken over, hope to see improvement. However, inflight service was friendly.
reviews.author: Lian Tiong G

reviews.title: Unreliable schedule
reviews.text: I flew Nam Air for the round trip between Bali and Labuan Bajo. Before I left home for Bali, I already received their emails twice for changing the time of the flights. The trip to Labuan Bajo delayed for more than an hour. During the whole waiting time, they had no announcement whatsoever regarding the delay and no information from the staff except 'not ready'. The flight back to Bali was rather on time though.
reviews.author: cherry.c

reviews.title: Worst airline ever
reviews.text: These people do not care! I have spent the last 4 hours at Labuan Boa (Komodo) airport, waiting for a flight. On checkin, they forgot to say that there was a 3 hour delay, just handed me the boarding pass. When the clock passes the departure time, I ask what time does the flight leave? “The plane is due to land here in 10 minutes”..........one hour later, and they still have made absolutely no announcement. Connecting flight to Australia has gone. Do not fly this awful airline.
reviews.author: Pete M

reviews.title: Mudik journey
reviews.text: I am very disappointed,when i'm enter the plane and looking for my seat, there is another one who have seated in my place and i ask the flight attendant why and they only answered me that the system is error and asking me for wait, and they give my seat to the other passenger that have same number with me, than i waited for 30 minutes without seat until the seat full, however i get my seat but the service is very slow, they can decided which ticket is the correct one
reviews.author: Sharen C

reviews.title: Good experience
reviews.text: Took return flight from Jakarta to Pangkalan Bun on NAM air (budget airline). Both flights were spot on time. They even serve water and a snack which we did not expect. Very friendly service. Plane was dated but both our short flights went smooth. For more legroom, ask during check in for an emergency exit row seat. Compliments!
reviews.author: Sneekie

reviews.title: Better than expected.
reviews.text: Aircraft was showing its age. My seat was broken on one side, my wife’s tray table could not be stowed as the catch was broken. It was a short flight, about one hour. A brown bag snack was served, I think it was a peanut butter roll of some sort, not too sure, but was OK. The bag also contained a small bottle of water and some dates in a zip lock bag. Staff were nice and friendly enough. The flight was very smooth with good landings on the flight out and the return. Baggage was extra and our checked bag made it Ok, although don’t expect a quick baggage collect. We had exit row seats both ways so leg room was good. Worth the cost (I think AU$9) each way.
reviews.author: Larry Goodwin

reviews.title: Great airline
reviews.text: I have no complaints about this airline at all. Both times I flew with them, the plane (737-500) was on time. Check-in was smooth, friendly staff, and easy flights. The flight from Denpasar to Komodo can be turbulent at times but nothing too bad at all. Also, they give you a sweet bun and some water which is nice and unexpected because the flight was only about 45 minutes. I would definitely fly with them again without hesitation.
reviews.author: Lucas

reviews.title: On time for 1st flight..but a little bit delayed 30 mnts for return flight.
reviews.text: On time for morning flight but 30 mnts delayed for return flight. Overall ok for 1 hours 20 mnts flight. The airplane was 737 500..it was old school plane but in a good way maintenance... But the air conditioner was bad...
reviews.author: Surya A

reviews.title: Recommended
reviews.text: As this was the only choice it is highly recommended! We enjoyed a smooth, on time service on a 737-900? Aircraft. Flights must be rather turbulent at times as barf bags wete prominently placed in the seat back pocket. We received a sweet bun and cup of water in a paper sack on our morning flight.
